description_en: Adds or modifies a masking whitelist
description_zh: 调用DsgWhiteListAddOrUpdate接口，新增或编辑脱敏白名单
name: DsgWhiteListAddOrUpdate

fields.help_en: The expiration time of the masking whitelist. A value of null indicates that the whitelist is permanently effective
fields.help_zh: 脱敏白名单的失效时间。输入null表示白名单永久生效
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en:
The ID of the masking whitelist.
If you do not specify this parameter, a masking whitelist is created.
If you specify this parameter, the specified masking whitelist is modified. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2786508.html operation to query the whitelist ID
fields.help_zh:
脱敏白名单ID。
不配置该参数：表示当前操作为新增脱敏白名单。
配置该参数：表示编辑指定脱敏白名单信息。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2786508.html接口查询白名单ID
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: The ID of the masking rule. First initialize the data classification and grading template in the Data Security Guard console, then call DsgDesensPlanAddOrUpdate to create a masking rule, and finally call DsgDesensPlanQueryList to obtain the RuleId
fields.help_zh: 脱敏规则 ID。请先在数据保护伞控制台完成分类分级模板初始化，再调用 DsgDesensPlanAddOrUpdate 创建脱敏规则，最后通过 DsgDesensPlanQueryList 获取 RuleId
fields.name: rule_id

fields.help_en:
The effective time of the masking whitelist.

Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. Example: `2024-04-10 00:00:00`
fields.help_zh:
脱敏白名单的生效时间。

格式示例为 `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，例如 `2024-04-10 00:00:00`
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en: The collection of user group IDs
fields.name: user_group_ids

Data.description_zh:

true：操作成功。
false：操作失败

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
